defs.def: to bend or move from a vertical position 前俯；后仰；倾斜

ex.s: First of all, lean the technique of nonstop writing.
ex.t: 首先，学习不间断写作的技巧。

ex.s: Galileo was not merely ambitious when he dropped objects of varying weights from the Leaning Tower at Pisa and timed their fall to the ground.
ex.t: 伽利略并非只是好高骛远，当他从比萨斜塔扔下重量不同的物体并计时它们落地时。

ex.s: At the core of Lancom is a world-class effective method that enhances language leaning with advanced technology.
ex.t: Lancom的核心是一种世界级的有效方法，借助先进技术提升语言学习。

ex.s: It leans so far on one side that if you dropped a stone from the top, which is 188 feet high, it would fall 16 feet from the base of the tower.
ex.t: 它倾斜得如此厉害，以至于如果你从188英尺高的顶部扔下一块石头，它会落在离塔基16英尺的地方。

defs.def: to rest on or against sth for support 倚靠；靠在；靠置

ex.s: Of course, I visited the beautiful leaning tower, which is eight floors high, each having a round of columns, rising one above another.
ex.t: 当然，我参观了那座美丽的斜塔，它高达八层，每层都有一圈圆柱，层层叠起。

defs.def: to make sth rest against sth in a sloping position 使斜靠
to depend on sb/sth for help and support 依靠，依赖（ … 的帮助和支持）
to try to influence sb by threatening them 对 … 施加压力；威胁；恐吓
without much flesh; thin and fit 人，尤指男人或动物

ex.s: Without thinking, I leaned down and gave her a hug.
ex.t: 我不假思索，弯下腰给了她一个拥抱。

ex.s: And the Good Morning Britain presenter says she’s been able to put a lot of what she’s leant into practice in her own home, preparing meals for sons, Sam, 14, Finn, 13, and Jack, 11.
ex.t: 这位《早安英国》主持人说，她已能把学到的很多东西付诸自家实践，为14岁的萨姆、13岁的芬恩和11岁的杰克三个儿子做饭。

defs.def: containing little or no fat 肉

ex.t: （邻居贝林戈特，一位倚着手杖的小老太太，走进来。）蒂蒂尔妈妈：你的小女孩怎么样？

ex.s: I know when students are really interested, however, because they lean forward and look at me.
ex.t: 然而，当学生真正感兴趣时，我能看出来，因为他们会身体前倾，看着我。
